name: Ring of the Evil Twin
body:
Aura faint illusion; CL 5th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of the twin. When activated in combat, however, the duplicate created is of the wearer’s opponent. This double is not controlled by the wearer and moves independently to flank the wearer for 5 rounds or until it is successfully attacked.

This ring can only be removed by the casting of remove curse, followed by true seeing, upon it which renders the ring non-magical.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of the twin

Identification DC 30
False Identification DC 20
